units: <cite ref="Pesachim 3a:14">Pes. 3ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Pesachim 3b:2">3ᵇ</cite> <he>ב׳ דגמלים</he> fear of falling down from the camel’s back; <he>ב׳ דליליא</he> fear of the night.
<cite ref="Shabbat 41a:3">Sabb. 41ᵃ</cite> <he>ב׳ דנהרא</he> fear of being drowned.
